children: Meituan’s AI team has launched DeepSkill, an AI agent skills platform that lists more than 370,000 tools validated through real-world tasks. According to ChainCatcher, the collection has grown from 130,000 tools in early September.

Instead of having users browse a directory, DeepSkill lets them describe a task, then breaks it down and matches relevant skills from its library. The platform also scans each skill’s full contents and generates a report covering its capabilities and limitations, tools it can call, potential risks, and data security. Its rankings include GitHub trends, authoritative sources, and Market searches. Tencent, ByteDance, and Alibaba have also established a presence in the skills platform sector.

title: Meituan Launches DeepSkill AI Agent Skills Platform With More Than 370,000 Tools
